verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a repo-resident `.coderabbit.yaml` (resolved via `@coderabbitai configuration`, with optional org-wide central config) that holds path filters excluding lock files and generated code, glob-based per-path instructions, AST-grep rules, and `reviews.*` settings such as auto_review and request_changes_workflow. missing for 10: explicit evidence of named review profiles (e.g. strictness/tone presets) in the config, independent or hands-on corroboration of the config workflow.
